notes: Every map's cliff spots expanded to 2x2 sites - room for a full battery of anti-air.
APEX RAIL: a kilometer-long railgun, 1,267 damage per round with a 4-second cooldown at max, extreme range.
TEMPEST GUN: six barrels fire insanely fast 2-second bursts at 523 max DPS, trailing smoke from every volley.
Both new towers sit on cliffs in the proper heavy price range (49.5k / 53.2k max-out).
TEMPEST GUN REWORK: fires a fast staggered burst of 4 rounds at max (3 at low levels) on a 3s base reload that upgrades down to exactly 2s; smoke still pours from every volley.
APEX RAIL REWORK: reloads start at 6 seconds and the cycler upgrades cut it to exactly 4s at max - a slower, heavier rhythm.
